description: The customManagers below rewrite a tag pin inside flake.nix, but a regex manager has no updateArtifacts hook — so flake.lock keeps pointing at the OLD tag and the PR is internally inconsistent.

nix then re-resolves and REWRITES flake.lock during evaluation, mutating the flake source tree after lazy-trees has already hashed it for any check whose src is the repo (checks.*.treefmt). That surfaces as 'store path ... was hashed to avoid a full copy at first, but upon reading it again, the contents have changed' and fails every runner deterministically. Seen on PR #54 (pplx-agent-tools v0.4.1).

`nix flake lock` (not `nix flake update`) re-resolves ONLY the inputs whose flake.nix spec no longer matches their lock entry, so unrelated inputs such as nixpkgs stay put. Verified against PR #54's broken tree: pplx-agent-tools moved v0.4.0 -> v0.4.1 and the nixpkgs rev was untouched.

Requires `nix` on PATH in renovate's own execution environment, which is why .github/workflows/renovate.yml runs renovate from nixpkgs instead of the Docker image, plus RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS there to permit this exact command.
